repeat.purpose: Independent architecture repeat only after at least 2% validated N52 goodput gain over both controls.

higher_load.purpose: Architecture N54 only after reproduced N52 gain, SLA at least 95% and mean ITL at most 19.3ms.

scope: One architecture pilot, one gated independent N52 repeat, then one gated N54; shared per-user cap five. No automatic contest promotion.
